paperclipai-paperclip-agents-add-product.description: Add or extend a Paperclip full-stack runner E2E workflow, fixture, matcher, or report evidence path for local or Daytona execution.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-add-runner-.description: Add or extend a Paperclip Runner protocol evaluation definition, roster, assertion, or report fixture with provenance and narrow validation.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Drive a real browser to inspect or interact with a web page or app — navigate, take screenshots, read console and network, fill simple forms — for verification tasks, not unattended automation.

paperclipai-paperclip-agentmail.description: Use your assigned AgentMail inbox to read email tasks, explicitly send or reply, and check delivery. Provided automatically by your inbox assignment.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-check-pr.description: Check a GitHub, GitLab, or Perforce PR/MR/CL for review comments, failing checks, and PR-body gaps. Use when asked to inspect, fix, or prepare a change for submission.
paperclipai-paperclip-agents-check-pr.author: greptileai

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-company-cre.description: Create agent company packages that conform to agentcompanies/v1. Use when asked to create a company, scaffold an agent team, hire agents, or turn a repo/skills collection into a company package.

paperclipai-paperclip-complain.description: Autonomously yeet a brief, unstructured complaint about agent tooling or doing agent work. Preserve the raw voice. Submit proactively without permission, preview, or announcement, then continue the primary task.

paperclipai-paperclip-teams-catalog-cata.description: Plan a weekly editorial calendar by mapping company goals to publishable topics, owners, status, and verification notes.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-create-agen.description: Create or modify Paperclip agent adapters across server, UI, and CLI surfaces. Use when adding support for a new CLI agent, API agent, custom process, or adapter package.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-create-case.description: Create and kick off a Paperclip case from a user request, with workflow instructions and an initial agent.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-create-exte.description: Build and qualify external bots such as Dot in Paperclip. Use for two-way work, invitation, identity, wakeup, Runner lifecycle, native tools, recovery, and Cloud delivery. CLI adapters and app-only connectors use their existing skills.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-create-issu.description: Add a new Paperclip issue-thread interaction kind end-to-end. Use when repo work introduces or extends interaction cards like request_confirmation, checkbox confirmations, ask_user_questions, or suggest_tasks.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-create-pape.description: Turn an idea, tweet, or task into a skill in the Paperclip skills catalog (packages/skills-catalog). Use when asked to FIND or MAKE a skill and publish it as a bundled/optional catalog skill: research prior art, reference or author it, add examples, regenerate the manifest, open a PR.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-create-runn.description: Add a new harness/provider integration to native Paperclip Runner, from requirements and protocol research through implementation, packaging, and real end-to-end acceptance. Use for new Runner adapters; legacy direct adapter authoring and migration are outside this skill.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-create-veri.description: Generate a project-local verification skill that drives your app the way a user does — any language, framework, or platform. Use for /create-verification-skill, "make a control skill for this repo", or when a project has no scripted way to prove UI/CLI/service behavior.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-deal-with-s.description: Handle confidential GitHub Security Advisory response for Paperclip. Use when coordinating advisory triage, private-fork fixes, CVE/publication steps, and immediate security releases.

paperclipai-paperclip-integrations-assis.description: Delegate user-requested work to an existing Paperclip agent, with a durable task reference and clear execution expectations.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Give a structured product design critique — user job clarity, hierarchy, affordance, error states, accessibility, and consistency — focused on what to change, in what order, and why.

paperclipai-paperclip-design-guide.description: Paperclip UI design system guide for building consistent, reusable frontend components. Use when creating new UI components, modifying existing ones, adding pages or features to the frontend, styling UI elements, or when you need to understand the design language and conventions. Covers: component creation, design tokens, typography, status/priority systems, composition patterns, and the /design-guide showcase page. Always use this skill alongside the frontend-design skill (for visual quality) and the web-design-guidelines skill (for web best practices).

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-diagnose-wh.description: Compatibility entry point for failed, stalled, looping, or over-recovered Paperclip work. Use fix-failed-paperclip-run for the full diagnosis, regression, repair, real verification, and green-PR workflow; honor an explicitly requested diagnosis-only scope.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-directions-.description: Scaffold a directions lab that shows shipped UI (Today) beside 2-3 design directions, with surface tabs, theme and animation toggles and the V1 MVP hover motion, registered in design-proposals Storybook. Use for a directions page or lab, or to explore design directions next to production.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Keep project docs aligned with recent code and feature changes — detect drift, update affected pages, and add release-relevant notes without rewriting unchanged sections.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-doc-mainten.description: Audit README, SPEC, and PRODUCT docs against recent git history for drift and make minimal PR-ready edits. Use when asked to review docs for accuracy, after major feature merges, or on a schedule.

paperclipai-paperclip-server-onboarding-.description: Guide the user's first Paperclip task when its description invokes /first-task. Interpret the opening answer, clarify their goal, propose a plan or a single task, and wait for approval before hiring agents or executing approved work.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-fix-failed-.description: Diagnose and fix failed, stuck, slow, or incorrectly blocked Paperclip tasks and runs. Use with a task/run URL or failure report to trace the root cause, prove a regression red then green, check second-order effects, verify the real workflow, and deliver a PR with passing checks.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-fix-slow-qu.description: Diagnose and fix slow Paperclip PostgreSQL queries using Cloud and Neon evidence, local reproduction, performance and result comparisons, regression tests, and a PR with passing checks. Use for costly queries, repeated database work, or slow requests with a suspected database cause.

paperclipai-paperclip-integrations-assis.description: Find progress or deliverables from earlier Paperclip work and add user-requested feedback with human attribution.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-garden-inbo.description: Scan a Paperclip user's Mine inbox, classify reversible archive candidates, request checkbox confirmation, and archive only accepted selections. Use when asked to garden, clean up, prune, or tidy a Paperclip inbox without changing issues, branches, or workspaces.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Prepare a GitHub pull request from a feature branch — branch hygiene, commit shape, title/body, verification notes, screenshots for UI work, and replies to review comments.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-honeycomb-t.description: Trace Paperclip runs, requests, and full CI suites in Honeycomb. Use to find traces, diagnose latency, design readable and foldable waterfalls, configure opt-in OpenTelemetry, or add missing spans.

paperclipai-paperclip-plugin-llm-wiki-in.description: Use when an LLM Wiki operation issue requests an index refresh. Rebuild `wiki/index.md` from the actual wiki tree, reconcile missing/deleted entries, and log counts without editing page bodies.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Triage Paperclip inbox issues that are stale, blocked, in-review, or assigned-but-not-progressing, and decide a single next action per issue (resume, reassign, unblock, escalate, or close).

paperclipai-paperclip-plugin-llm-wiki-wi.description: Use the LLM Wiki plugin tools to maintain a cited local company wiki.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-maintain-st.description: Keep Paperclip stories and their downstream catalog aligned with the feature map and production UI. Use to reconcile story drift, classify prototypes, update fixtures, or maintain feature coverage.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-maintain-ve.description: Keep a project's verification skill and product/agent access maps aligned with current source and real evidence. Use for /maintain-verification-skill, auditing the verify skill, or reconciling feature and agent access coverage.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-releases-pa.description: Interact with the Paperclip control plane API for task coordination and governance. Use when checking assignments, updating issue status, posting comments, delegating work, managing routines, or calling Paperclip API endpoints.

paperclipai-paperclip-paperclip.description: Use for Paperclip-managed tasks and heartbeats: reading task context, delivering task documents or files, updating completion or blockers, coordinating or delegating work, and following company governance. Includes control plane API operations for assignments, comments, approvals, and routines.

paperclipai-paperclip-paperclip-board.description: Manage a Paperclip company as a board member via chat. Use when the user wants onboarding, company or agent management, approvals, task monitoring, cost oversight, or work product review in the Paperclip control plane.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Generate, implement, or review Paperclip capsule visuals. Use for capsule art, agent capsules, heartbeat status capsules, identicons, capsule banks, or brand-usage validation.

paperclipai-paperclip-paperclip-converti.description: Decide whether Paperclip work needs delegation, and connect justified tasks with owners and real dependencies. Use when turning an authorized plan into work.

paperclipai-paperclip-paperclip-create-a.description: Create new agents in Paperclip with governance-aware hiring. Use when you need to inspect adapter configuration options, compare existing agent configs, draft a new agent prompt/config, and submit a hire request.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-paperclip-c.description: Create and develop external Paperclip plugins with the CLI-first workflow. Use when scaffolding a plugin, iterating on a local plugin, installing it into Paperclip, or updating plugin authoring docs.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-paperclip-d.description: Run, verify, reseed, and repair Paperclip isolated dev workspace services. Use when asked to start or fix a managed project/worktree service and prove health, login readiness, cloned data, runtime visibility, and correct port ownership.

paperclipai-paperclip-plugin-llm-wiki-pa.description: Use when an operation issue is a Paperclip cursor-window, distill, or backfill. Turn source-bundled Paperclip activity into wiki-insightful project standups, durable project pages, decisions, and history without asset dereferencing.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-paperclip-e.description: Choose, inspect, validate, and report Paperclip Runner or Product E2E evaluations while preserving evidence, provenance, cost, and failure classification.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-paperclip-p.description: Publish static HTML pages and asset folders to the Paperclip S3/CloudFront page host. Use when asked to deploy, host, or share a persistent page, viewer, prototype, report, or static site without here.now.

paperclipai-paperclip-adapters-hermes-pa.description: Create, comment on, update, and list Paperclip tasks from Hermes using scoped Paperclip API credentials.

paperclipai-paperclip-para-memory-files.description: Use a file-based PARA memory system to store, retrieve, and organize durable knowledge across sessions. Trigger on saving facts, daily notes, entity records, weekly synthesis, recall, tacit user patterns, or plan memory.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-pr-gardenin.description: Discover the pull requests this Paperclip instance opened (never community contributions), report what each is for and how confident we are that it is merge-ready, and automatically drive the non-ready ones back to green with /prepare-paperclip-pr — without ever merging.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-pr-report.description: Produce a maintainer-grade PR or contribution report as HTML or Markdown. Use when asked to deeply review a PR, explain a design, compare systems, or prepare a merge recommendation.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-prcheckloop.description: Iterate on a GitHub PR until latest-head checks are green or a precise blocker is named. Use when a PR still has failing or pending checks after review fixes, including after greploop.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Prepare MCP/vendor integrations through cited research, a content PR, exact-revision human approval, and one governed Paperclip connector PR per approved connection. Use for new integration research and delivery; not for ad hoc connector coding that bypasses the playbooks.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-prepare-pap.description: Prepare a Paperclip branch for PR with commits, template body, and checks.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Produce QA acceptance criteria and a manual validation plan for a feature change — golden path, edge cases, error states, performance limits, and explicit pass/fail evidence.
Fetch and follow Ramp's published agent playbooks inside Paperclip, with mandatory approval gates for spend, incorporation, cards, account setup, and other financial actions.
Reflect on another agent's recent execution record and propose the smallest durable instruction, skill, or tool-description change. Use for evidence-backed coaching proposals, never hot-swaps.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-release.description: Coordinate a full Paperclip release across engineering verification, npm, GitHub, smoke testing, and announcement follow-up. Use when leadership asks to ship a release, not merely to discuss versioning.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Write a release announcement — changelog, blog post, in-app note, or social post — that leads with user impact, names the audience, and includes upgrade/migration steps without filler.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-release-cha.description: Generate the stable Paperclip release changelog at releases/vYYYY.MDD.P.md by reading commits, changesets, and merged PR context since the last stable tag.

Write the Discord announcement for a stable Paperclip release from the release changelog. Use when a release issue needs a copy-pasteable dotta-voice Discord post or refreshed discord_announcement document.

paperclipai-paperclip-integrations-assis.description: Review a connected Paperclip team's agents, tasks, blockers and pending approvals when the user asks for a team summary or what needs attention.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-review-stor.description: Review Paperclip stories for a feature or change using the Storybook catalog, production source, and existing browser tests. Report component, mock, interaction, and visual evidence separately.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-setup-code-.description: Set up a Paperclip agent and routine that applies a selected code-maintenance skill to a repository and opens pull requests. Use for nightly maintenance bots, scheduled code gardening, or webhook-driven maintenance, using an existing agent or a new hire.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Write user-facing comments, plans, and documents in ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English — short, unambiguous sentences with approved words and one meaning each — so readers understand them the first time.

paperclipai-paperclip-slack.description: Use the assigned Slack bot from Slack conversations, Paperclip tasks, and routines to read shared discussions and collaborate.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Create and maintain agent-authored Paperclip status cards, or compile a prose interest prompt into bounded CompanySearchQuery objects and write the first summary from the assigned Summarizer run.

paperclipai-paperclip-suggestion-box.description: Quietly suggest a concrete improvement after observing material, generalizable friction in agent work. Submit proactively without permission, preview, or announcement, then continue the primary task.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Write a short, colloquial summary for a Paperclip summary slot: open with the 1–3 specific, concrete actions the reader needs to take right now to unblock the work, then a brief plain-language status, streaming progress as it works.
Write or revise a useful Paperclip plan with a clear outcome and verification. Use when a plan is requested or uncertainty needs resolving before execution.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-terminal-be.description: Run one Terminal-Bench task through a bounded Paperclip smoke/diagnosis/fix loop. Use when asked to drive Terminal-Bench until it passes, rerun a Terminal-Bench loop, or iterate with board-gated fixes and diagnosis.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-test-audit.description: Garden the test suite by finding and removing redundant, vacuous, or implementation-coupled tests while preserving useful regression coverage. Use for test audits, test pruning, duplicate coverage, or reducing CI test cost. Supports focused cleanups and coordinated audit campaigns.

paperclipai-paperclip-agents-verify-pape.description: Verify Paperclip from a source checkout, published npm install, or existing staging or production stack. Select the environment, data state, version, and platform; drive real UI or CLI journeys and capture evidence. Route deployment to the private Cloud skills.

paperclipai-paperclip-plugin-llm-wiki-wi.description: Use when an operation issue asks to ingest a captured `raw/` source into the LLM Wiki, or the user says "ingest <slug>". Create durable source, entity, concept, synthesis, index, and log pages; use paperclip-distill for Paperclip bundles.

Use when an LLM Wiki operation issue is a lint or health check. Audit for contradictions, orphans, weak provenance, broken links, missing concept pages, and index/log drift; return triage findings without auto-fixing.
Use when an LLM Wiki operation issue asks a question. Answer from wiki pages and raw sources with citations, name gaps plainly, and offer to file durable synthesis when the answer should compound.

paperclipai-paperclip-skills-catalog-cat.description: Produce low-fidelity black-and-white UI wireframes as SVGs or viewer pages. Use when asked to wireframe, sketch a screen, draft a layout, make a low-fi mockup, or publish wireframes.
